name: Manglik Dosha
caused_by: Mars placed in 1st, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th house from Lagna or Moon.
effects: Delays in marriage, aggressive behavior in relationships, financial instability, disharmony in marital life.
cancellation_conditions: If Mars is in own sign (Aries/Scorpio) or exalted (Capricorn), dosha is cancelled. If Jupiter aspects Mars, dosha is reduced.
remedies: Kumbh Vivah (marrying an earthen pot first).
Offer sindoor and jasmine flowers to Lord Hanuman.
